title: Magic Flight Launch Box Battery Set
description:
Looking for the perfect power source for your Magic Flight Launch Box? This Battery set includes two high-quality nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) AA rechargeable batteries with a whopping 2250mAh capacity.

Designed specifically for use with the Magic Flight Launch Box, these batteries provide an experience like no other. With an average of two to three complete trenches per charge, you can enjoy extended vaping sessions without worrying about running out of power. Simply use any stock Magic-Flight charger or power adapter and keep your magic flight vaporizers going strong. Say hello to uninterrupted enjoyment with the Magic Flight Launch Box Battery Set!
